name: Kill Z: Battle Royale
summary:
Kill Z is a third-person Battle Royale shooter that brings together some of the best mechanics of the Battle Royale genre to create a fresh and unique multiplayer experience, featuring intense combat, survival, and large-scale encounters.

Powered by the latest Unreal Engine 5 technology, Kill Z aims to deliver exceptional visual fidelity, detailed environments, and immersive gameplay.

Currently available for Windows PC and under active development, with macOS, Linux, and other platforms planned for the future.
